title: The Sapphire Cord Canon
summary: A canon of the sapphire academy that spins cords of deep blue soul force and ends in an immurement no technique can leave.

title: The Skysworn Treatise on Held Souls
summary: A treatise of the Skysworn on taking a soul into custody and keeping it held under a warden's seal until it is released.

title: The Azure Guard's Book of Fetters
summary: A book of the Azure Guard on tempered fetters that hold a soul and on a warding fetter that turns a binding back on its caster.

title: Canon of the Unbroken Tether
summary: A canon of the tether that does not snap under strain and holds a soul for as long as the caster's will endures.

title: The Stormwing Binding Cycle
summary: A cycle of the Stormwing Order that stoops on a soul like a raptor and drops a net of soul force over the whole field.

title: The Oath-Voices' Book of Bonds
summary: A book of the Oath-Voices on bonds struck by spoken pact that witness a given word and bind those who would break it.

title: The Long Coast Net Canon
summary: A canon of mesh and net cast wide and hauled in tight that holds a crowd of souls in one drawing.

title: The Last Knot Treatise
summary: A treatise for the soul of full form that ties the knot no hand can untie and holds a soul to its last ending.
